items.title: Steve Turré interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 29, 2021
items.q: [(boilerplate)] Steve was interviewed via Zoom on November 29, 2021 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

ctx.x: Steve was interviewed via Zoom on November 29, 2021 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
I’m very happy to have Steve Turré with me today and my name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive. Thank you for joining me.
